agyos_skill.intent: Expert guide for Odoo HR and Payroll: salary structures, payslip rules, leave policies, employee contracts, and payroll journal entries.
agyos_skill.instructions: This skill guides HR managers and payroll accountants through setting up Odoo HR and Payroll correctly. It covers salary structure creation with Python-computed rules, time-off policies, employee contract types, and the payroll → accounting journal posting flow. - Creating a salary structure with gross pay, deductions, and net pay. - Configuring annual leave, sick leave, and public holiday policies. - Troubleshooting incorrect payslip amounts or missing rule contributions. - Setting up the payroll journal to correctly post to accounting. 1. **Activate**: Mention `@odoo-hr-payroll-setup` and describe your payroll scenario. 2. **Configure**: Receive step-by-step setup for salary rules and leave allocation. 3. **Debug**: Paste a salary rule or payslip issue and receive a root cause analysis. ```text Menu: Payroll → Configuration → Salary Structures → New Name: US Employee Monthly Payslip Code: MONTHLY Rules (executed top-to-bottom — order matters): Code | Name | Formula | Category ----- | ---------------------- | ------------------------------ | --------- BASIC | Basic Wage | contract.wage | Basic GROSS | Gross | BASIC | Gross SS | Social Security (6.2%) | -GROSS * 0.062 | Deduction MED | Medicare (1.45%) | -GROSS * 0.0145 | Deduction FIT | Federal Income Tax | -GROSS * inputs.FIT_RATE.amount| Deduction NET | Net Salary | GROSS + SS + MED + FIT | Net ``` > **Federal Income Tax:** The standard Odoo US localization does not expose a single `l10n_us_w4_rate` field. Use an **input** (salary input type) to pass the withholding rate per employee, or install a community US payroll module (OCA `l10n_us_hr_payroll`) which handles W4 filing status properly. ```text Menu: Time Off → Configuration → Time Off Types → New
